problem: merge now assigns plc = lc (only when hi > phi and lo == plo), so a wider open-lower interval overwrites the closed lower flag and drops the lower endpoint, e.g. normalize([(1,2),(1,3,False,True)]) gives (1,3,False,True) instead of (1,3,True,True).
No tests cover merging intervals with equal lower bounds and mixed closed/open flags, so the regression in F1 is undetected.
